recipes.label: Consult with a Sniper?
recipes.startdescription: If the infantry and tanks are our hammers, these men are our scalpels. I can order them into a hiding place to increase their effectiveness.

Not soldiers, but fighters all the same, and high in spirit. I can send them into town to offer the locals relief, or to strongarm those same locals into being useful. They should be more familiar with the local terrain than the average soldier. If I have I hiding place for them, it would increase their effectiveness.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally
recipes.startdescription: Their war is over, but ours isn't. If we have time and effort to spare, we could bury them properly. [You will gain a memory from this.]
recipes.description: They Fought, and now they rest in a proper grave. I think about them briefly, and move on.

recipes.label: Bury a Fallen Ally?
recipes.startdescription: With some effort and time, I can bury these allies to give them some proper rest. Or if I'm desperate enough, I could do something else with them...

recipes.label: Pointless
recipes.startdescription: There is nothing to look back on. There is no meaning to this.

recipes.label: <color=red>Worthless<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>This is all they deserve.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner. Certain allies may need more provisions.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
recipes.description: Extra rations and rest. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Refresh an ally with Provisions?
recipes.startdescription: If I have extra provisions to spare, I can give them to my exhuasted allies to get them back in the fight sooner.
recipes.description: Extra rations and rest. Back in the fight.

recipes.label: Assistance From Locals!
recipes.startdescription: Our assistance to the locals here has given an unexpected boon, some townspeople come forward to tell us about the enemy...
recipes.description: The locals have shared information about enemy positions and composition. We can use this to our advantage.

recipes.label: Learn from a slain creature?
recipes.startdescription: This creature fought and lost, but in the breaking of this cadaver, I may learn more about the forging of monsters.
recipes.description: What is broken can be reforged into something deadlier. Knowledge is strength, after all.

recipes.label: Learn from a slain creature?
recipes.startdescription: This creature fought and lost, but in the breaking of this cadaver, I may learn more about the forging of monsters.
recipes.description: What is broken can be reforged into something deadlier. Knowledge is strength, after all.

recipes.label: Learn from a fallen monster?
recipes.startdescription: My friend told me to learn about monsters, but I have no idea where to start. I should take this somewhere else.

recipes.label: My Tormentor
recipes.startdescription: The monster called Exile is here. And I am afraid.

recipes.label: My Friend
recipes.startdescription: My Comrade-in-Arms. I should talk to him.

recipes.label: My Comrade
recipes.startdescription: My Comrade-in-Duty. I should talk to him.

recipes.label: Why?
recipes.startdescription: These people don't have a future. Why should I waste time allieviating their suffering?

recipes.label: <color=red>Useless<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>All they are getting from me is fire and agony.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Hope, Denied
recipes.startdescription: I'm not trying to get somewhere safer, not anymore.

recipes.label: Relief, Denied
recipes.startdescription: Their wounded are their problem, not mine.

recipes.label: <color=red>Hope, Rejected<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>My hope was unmade. Theirs will be unmade too, eventually.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: <color=red>Relief, Rejected<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>They will probably die from their wounds. Who is going to help them? The Germans, the Soviets? Certainly not me.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Glory's Repugnance
recipes.startdescription: Its hard to convince someone to join you for their benefit when you're an existential threat to them. Nothing but a gun to their head or a knife to their throat will convince them to join me. [Deserters can't be recruited with winter or grail while possessing the vulneration-in-glory.]

recipes.label: Emptiness
recipes.startdescription: If there's a God, he had abandoned me a long time ago.

recipes.label: <color=red>Nothingness<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>If there's a God, he will have to beg my forgiveness.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.description: In our victory, we hear a song, a hint. The secrets of this creature are ours, now.

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.description: In our victory, we hear a voice, a hint. The secrets of this creature are ours, now.

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.description: The nightmare recedes. The rage of the Wolf-grame could not overcome my rage. and I am angry.

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.description: The nightmare recedes. Accursed purpose drives me, and I will not rest until it is done. Heaven and Earth wont stop me, and this hell certainly wont.

recipes.label: A Victory!
recipes.description: The nightmare recedes. My past will not consume my present or my future. I won't allow it.

recipes.label: The Songs of Water and Mist
recipes.startdescription: The clicking and keening of the birds overhead begins to sound like something else entirely. In tinny voices of flute-breeze and wood-children, the birds exchange secrets and gossip. 'The sword,' a chorus of them sing. 'The sword...'
recipes.description: A little closer to the sword, now.

recipes.label: Contemplate under night?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has fully receded to nothingness. I have some time to rest, before I go back towards an ending. What might I ponder, under the absence of light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under night?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has fully receded to nothingness. I have some time to rest, before I go back towards an ending. What might I ponder, under the absence of light?
recipes.description: Nothing consequential, I suppose.

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sun?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has reached its zenith. I find some time to rest, before duty calls me back. What might I ponder, under the light of the sun?

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sun?
recipes.startdescription: The sun has reached its zenith. I find some time to rest, before duty calls me back. What might I ponder, under the light of the sun?
recipes.description: Nothing consequential, I suppose.

recipes.label: Contemplate under the sunset?
recipes.startdescription: The sun is retreating from the moon. I find some time to rest, before liberation calls me back. What might I ponder, under the fading light?

recipes.label: Contemplate under sunset?
recipes.startdescription: The sun is retreating from the moon. I find some time to rest, before liberation calls me back. What might I ponder, under the fading light?
recipes.description: Nothing consequential, I suppose.

recipes.label: Prepare ally to Evacuate Early
recipes.startdescription: We will have to leave eventually. I want this one to leave earlier than the others, though.
recipes.description: Done. This one is ready to bail out on command.

recipes.label: Cancel preparations to Evacuate Early
recipes.startdescription: This one is prepared to leave before the others. I could order otherwise.
recipes.description: Done. This one will evacuate with the others.

recipes.label: Cannibalise the Fallen?
recipes.startdescription: I'm not about to stoop that low. They don't deserve this.

recipes.label: Convert Hindrances to Opportunities?
recipes.startdescription: My word is command inviolate. And by my word, my path shall be clear.
recipes.description: I will not shirk in my path forward. I will not be denied.

recipes.label: Convert a Hindrance to Something Useful
recipes.startdescription: I close my eyes and focus my hearing. I can construct a path forward...
recipes.description: I open my eyes. My path is clearer.

recipes.label: Convert a Hindrance to Something Useful?
recipes.startdescription: The colonel is deaf, but hears everything. And so do I. [Use this card with a hindrance to convert it to something useful.]

recipes.label: Raise a Conscript
recipes.startdescription: All soldierly dead pass through the colonel's hands before the Elegiast's, but the power in my prosthesis will let me raise this one to fight for me before they go to him.
recipes.description: The names on my prosthesis glow. The conscript rises, and salutes me. Back to duty once more.

recipes.label: Raise a Conscript?
recipes.startdescription: The dead took oaths in life. The power in this prosthesis can remind them of that. [Slot a corpse in to raise it as a conscript.]

recipes.label: Shakedown a Church?
recipes.startdescription: Refugees and holy men reside here. I don't have it in me to take what little they have, yet.

recipes.label: Shakedown a Church
recipes.startdescription: Refugees and holy men reside here. What little they have will be more useful for me than for them. I might even get some 'volunteers' out of this. [This may produce refugees, provisions, or nothing at all. This might also cause infamy, desertion, and hostile locals.]
recipes.description: What's theirs is mine. They should be grateful I haven't outright killed them.

recipes.label: <color=red>Raze a Church<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: People who still have hope for a better future cower here, away from this war. I've got their future right here. [This will cause desertion, infamy, and hostile locals. It might produce something helpful, or not.]
recipes.description: <color=red>Wolf's work. Breathe deep, and smell the ashes of hope and rubble. A taste of what I have planned for this city.<color=#005500>

recipes.label: Loose a petrifying roar?
recipes.startdescription: I double over, every muscle in my body taut with rage. I cannot see anything but red. My lungs fill with air, but when I open my mouth, the sound that comes - the sound -
recipes.description:
The ground rumbles. Birds shake in the sky. Trees twist. The echo of my voice resounds through the Colonel's city. No other place would any creature dare answer my challenge, except here.

[Enemies won't be intimidated in the Colonel's city.]

recipes.label: Call upon the earth to destroy enemy infrastructure
recipes.startdescription: We have the support of the earth, and something we don't want on earth. Convenient.
recipes.description: What is on earth cannot escape it's wrath.

recipes.label: Unmake
recipes.startdescription: A shadow falls across my soul, and hatred deeper and older than my own moves through me - through my veins and into my hands, burning. I reach out for my obstacle -
recipes.description: Nothing remains. Utterly nothing.

recipes.label: Unmake
recipes.startdescription: A shadow falls across my soul, and hatred deeper and older than my own moves through me - through my veins and into my hands, burning. I reach out for my obstacle -
recipes.description: Nothing remains. Utterly nothing.

recipes.label: Dealing with Marinette?
recipes.startdescription: If I want to deal with my Dry-Witch problem in totality, I'm going to have to unmake all the Ivories and the Blood-on-Hand's Marinette's brought with her. I will also need the <color=red>Desire<color=#005500> to utterly end her.

recipes.label: Annihilation over Desire
recipes.startdescription: A hatred stronger than desire moves through my soul and my flesh. A great howling resounds through the wasteland. I reach out for Marinette...
recipes.description: A great shadow consumes Marinette. I hear a bloodcurdling, unnatural scream and then nothing. She won't be a problem anymore.

recipes.label: Too Late
recipes.startdescription: The road I am on permits neither peace nor redemption. That ending is unmade to me, now.

recipes.label: <color=red>Foolishness<color=#005500>
recipes.startdescription: <color=red>I loathe the very concept.<color=#005500>
